description: M64's OWN spec, not M62's. It exists only to score the arms M62's acceptance-spec.json cannot carry because they did not exist when it was written: the argmax baseline under its new name. Tolerances are copied VERBATIM from M62's spec and no threshold is changed -- if you are diffing the two, the only intended differences are `arms` and this description. M62's file is not touched by M64.

roles.instrument: binary-independent arithmetic. If one of these fails the HARNESS changed, and no verdict about any merge can be issued.
roles.decision: the claim under test. Must PASS for CERTIFY.
roles.power: an invocation that is supposed to score at or below `selector_ceiling`. Discipline 419: a battery whose failing arms have all vanished certifies nothing.

arms.name: A0-ladder
arms.note: two rungs only; the full ladder is graded by M62's own run and is not re-litigated here.

arms.name: SELECTOR-argmax-baseline
arms.note: M64 PR7. This is the invocation that RETAINS the semantics of M62's `SELECTOR-shipped` arm, which measured `stack` and now measures the estimator because M64 renamed the entry point. M62 pre-registered that transfer as NO-POWER rather than FAIL; this arm is where the lost control went. 0.7690 at a8eddc0 under the old name.
